tinker.name: Timestamp Converter
tinker.description: Timestamp and date converter with timezone support

zh-CN.name: 时间戳转换
zh-CN.description: 时间戳与日期双向转换，支持多时区

now.description: Get the current timestamp and sync the plugin UI to now. Optional unit and timezone.

unit.description: Timestamp unit. Defaults to the current UI selection.

timezone.description: Timezone like UTC+08:00. Defaults to the current UI selection. Use get to list valid values.

to_timestamp.description: Convert a date/time to a timestamp. Updates the plugin UI.

unit.description: Timestamp unit. Defaults to the current UI selection.

timezone.description: Timezone like UTC+08:00. Defaults to the current UI selection.

to_date.description: Convert a timestamp to a date/time string. Updates the plugin UI.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in the selected unit (milliseconds or seconds)

unit.description: Timestamp unit. Defaults to the current UI selection.

timezone.description: Timezone like UTC+08:00. Defaults to the current UI selection.

get.description: Get the current converter state, including unit, timezone, now, and both conversion panels.
